description: This header file defines the WebPA Abstraction APIs, error codes, data types, configuration parameters, and function prototypes for WebPA communication and management in a device management context.

methods.name: msgBusInit
methods.description: Initializes the message bus and registers the WebPA component with the stack.

methods.name: setInitialNotifyConfigFile
methods.description: Sets the initial notify configuration file.

methods.name: processRequest
methods.description: Processes a request and returns a response payload.

methods.name: setInitialNotify
methods.description: Sets the initial notify parameters from the config file.

methods.name: loadCfgFile
methods.description: Loads and parses the WebPA config file to extract parameters.

methods.name: waitForConnectReadyCondition
methods.description: Waits until all components required for connecting to the server are initialized.

methods.name: waitForOperationalReadyCondition
methods.description: Waits until all components required for operation are initialized.
